animations.name: Magnetic Confirm
animations.description: Tactile CTA lift with glow, scale, and spring feedback.
animations.framer: whileHover={{ scale: 1.04, y: -3 }} whileTap={{ scale: 0.98 }} transition={{ type: 'spring', stiffness: 360, damping: 24 }}

animations.name: Liquid Toggle
animations.description: Glass toggle with a morphing spring thumb.

animations.name: Orbital Loader
animations.description: Rotating orbit with a pulsing center for premium loading states.
animations.framer: animate={{ rotate: 360 }} transition={{ duration: 2.4, repeat: Infinity, ease: 'linear' }}

animations.name: Glass Route Shift
animations.description: Page transition using fade, vertical drift, and blur.
animations.framer: initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 28, filter: 'blur(16px)' }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0, filter: 'blur(0px)' }} exit={{ opacity: 0, y: -18, filter: 'blur(10px)' }}
